test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: As on March 2021, which of the following states does NOT have an export-processing zone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **March 2021**, **Bihar does not have** an **Export-Processing Zone**.
 
• **Falta Special Economic Zone (earlier FEPZ) **was set up by the **Government of India** in the **year 1984**.
 
• **Export Processing Zones** are **specialized areas** in a country where **tariffs are eliminated** in the hope of **attracting FDI and new business**.
 
• **Asia’s first EPZ **was set up in **Kandla in 1965**.
 
• **Seven more zones **were **set up **thereafter.
 
• In correcting **EPZ model flaws**, **new features were added** to the **SEZ Policy **introduced in **April 2000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **All the eight Export Processing Zones (EPZs) located at:**

 
 
• **Kandla **(Gujarat)
 
• **Surat **(Gujarat)
 
• **Santa Cruz** (Maharashtra)
 
• **Cochin** (Kerala)
 
• **Chennai**(Tamil Nadu)
 
• **Visakhapatnam** (Andhra Pradesh)
 
• **Falta **(West Bengal)
 
• **Noida** (U.P.)
